verdict_detail: Upstream's documented vLLM-Omni offline-inference path installs and runs on this host. Installed exactly per vllm-omni docs (getting_started/installation/gpu, AMD ROCm tab): vllm==0.28.0+rocm723 from wheels.vllm.ai + vllm-omni==0.28.0 + onnxruntime swapped for onnxruntime-rocm, in an isolated gitignored venv (.work-vllm/venv, python 3.12.3). The ROCm wheel embeds compiled gfx1151 code objects (strings of _rocm_C.abi3.so: gfx1100 gfx1101 gfx1150 gfx1151 gfx1200 gfx1201 gfx90a gfx942 gfx950) and vllm's RocmPlatform detects 'AMD_Radeon_8060S' (capability 11.5). The documented smallest offline example (vllm-omni end2end.py --query-type CustomVoice, byte-unmodified, model resolved from the repo's local models/ dir via an HF_HOME cache symlink) ran to completion twice, producing a finite non-silent 6.0 s / 24 kHz WAV. SCOPE LIMITS: one example, single configuration (CustomVoice single sample, 1.7B), isolated venv separate from the validated .venv stack; no serving, no performance or quality claims, no integration. Per the roadmap ladder this upgrades the row to a feasibility-proven rung only.
